About me

Shaping stories that move people

Based in Kozhikode, Kerala, with an MA in Journalism and Mass Communication and a PG Diploma in Filmmaking and Video Production from MediaOne Academy. I’ve worked as Assistant DOP, Assistant Camera and Assistant Director, covering camera work, framing, lighting, production workflow and on-set collaboration.

Services

  1. 01. Videography & Cinematography

    Camera operation, framing and lighting for short films, advertising and visual stories, shot to look the way you imagined.

  2. 02. Interviews & Video Stories

    Camera setup and operation while working closely with subjects and locations to capture honest, natural moments.

  3. 03. Video Editing

    Post-production that shapes raw footage into a clear, engaging story with pace, sound and polish.

  4. 04. Events & Production Crew

    Live coverage, stage operations and on-ground production coordination for festivals, conclaves and large events.
